source.title: Anthropic reported diary entry to police, woman faces felony charge
source.author: emptybits

title.en: Claude Diary Case Raises Privacy Questions

excerpt.zh: Claude日记事件显示，聊天机器人中的高风险内容可能触发人工审查和警方通报，用户不应把AI当作绝对私密的日记。
excerpt.en: The Claude diary case shows that high-risk chatbot content may reach human reviewers and police, so users should not treat AI chats as fully private.

text.zh: Claude日记事件：聊天内容如何升级处理
text.en: Claude Diary Case: How a Chat Escalated

text.zh: 据报道，一名佛罗里达州女子把Claude当作日记使用，并写下计划袭击警长办公室的内容。Anthropic的安全系统标记了这段对话，随后交由人工审核；审核人员认为威胁可能可信，并向执法部门报告。警方之后到她家中将其拘留，她目前面临一项与书面暴力威胁有关的重罪指控。案件事实和法律责任仍应以官方记录及司法程序为准。
text.en: According to the supplied report, a Florida woman used Claude as a diary and wrote about plans to attack the sheriff's office. Anthropic's safety system flagged the conversation and sent it to a human reviewer, who judged the threat potentially credible and contacted law enforcement. Deputies later detained her at home, and she faces a felony charge related to a written threat of violence. The precise facts and legal responsibility remain matters for official records and court proceedings.

text.zh: Anthropic的披露政策与用户隐私边界
text.en: Anthropic's Disclosure Policy and Privacy Boundaries

text.zh: Anthropic表示，在有限的紧急情况下，如果公司认为披露信息有助于防止死亡或严重人身伤害，可能会分享用户资料。这意味着聊天记录并不等同于只供本人阅读的私人日记：自动检测、人工审查和紧急披露都可能成为处理链条的一部分。报道还提到，其他AI服务的提示词、上传内容或生成结果也可能被人工承包商看到，具体取决于产品和审查任务。
text.en: Anthropic says it may share user information in limited emergencies when it believes disclosure is necessary to prevent death or serious physical injury. That policy means a chatbot transcript is not equivalent to a diary intended only for its writer: automated detection, human review, and emergency disclosure can all form part of the handling process. The report also notes that contractors for other AI services may see prompts, uploads, or generated results, depending on the product and the review assignment.

text.zh: Claude日记事件留下的关键问题
text.en: The Open Questions Behind the Claude Diary Case

text.zh: 这起案件的核心影响不只是“不要在聊天机器人里写敏感内容”，还包括平台如何区分真实威胁、夸张表达、虚构写作和求助信号。过度谨慎可能扩大隐私和误报风险，过度宽松则可能错过现实危险。公开信息尚不足以判断审核依据、转交标准及通知流程是否足够透明，因此用户在输入潜在威胁、个人隐私或违法相关内容前，应先阅读服务条款，并假设内容可能被保存或审查。
text.en: The broader lesson is not merely to avoid sensitive writing in chatbots. Platforms must distinguish credible threats from hyperbole, fiction, and requests for help. Excessive intervention can create privacy and false-positive concerns, while insufficient intervention may miss genuine danger. The supplied information does not establish how the reviewer weighed the statement, how the referral threshold was applied, or whether the process was transparent enough. Users should therefore read service terms and assume that potentially threatening, highly personal, or legally sensitive messages may be retained or reviewed.
